tools.name: spike_echo
tools.title: Spike echo
tools.description: Use for: Phase 0 platform tests only; echoes the message back. Not for: any real work.

tools.name: spike_echo_3mb
tools.title: Spike echo (3 MB widget)
tools.description: Use for: Phase 0 widget-size test only; echoes the message back and renders a ~3 MB widget. Not for: any real work.

tools.name: spike_echo_6mb
tools.title: Spike echo (6 MB widget)
tools.description: Use for: Phase 0 widget-size test only; echoes the message back and renders a ~6 MB widget. Not for: any real work.

tools.name: spike_write
tools.title: Spike write
tools.description: Use for: Phase 0 test T4 only (a model-callable tool that is not read-only). This is a Phase 0 test tool that records nothing: it writes no data anywhere and only returns what it would have written. Not for: any real work.

tools.name: spike_write_app
tools.title: Spike write (app only)
tools.description: Phase 0 test T3 only: callable by the widget, hidden from the model. This is a Phase 0 test tool that records nothing: it writes no data anywhere and only returns what it would have written.

tools.name: spike_unannotated
tools.description: Use for: Phase 0 test T12 only; echoes the message back from a tool that declares no annotations. Not for: any real work.

tools.name: spike_whoami
tools.title: Spike who am I
tools.description: Use for: Phase 0 auth test T5 only; returns the caller's Dataverse systemuserid (on-behalf-of) and which token claims are present. Not for: any real work.
